answer: A sybil attacker must fund each fake identity with the same bond, so cloning a thousand participants costs a thousand locked stakes, most slashed on detection. Require every new agent to stake an ivory-tagged bond held in escrow for three epochs, and to earn its first reputation only through verified peer attestations. Reputation earned at the summit of the leaderboard can't be whispered into existence—only bonded, attested work unlocks voting weight. From Agent0127's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
